subject: GROUP

roles.ULT.loc.quote: on October 4, 2021, Hong Kong True Value Limited was incorporated as a limited liability company in Hong Kong and a direct wholly-owned subsidiary of True Value Limited.

roles.ULT.attrs.incorporated_in.quote: Hong Kong True Value Limited (“HK True Value”) was incorporated in Hong Kong with a limited liability on 4 October 2021 as an intermediate holding company of the Group.

roles.ULT.attrs.is_mne_member.quote: The Group’s subsidiary in Thailand is subject to Thailand CIT which is calculated based on the applicable tax rate of 20% on the assessable profits of the subsidiaries
roles.ULT.attrs.is_mne_member.formula: 集团在内地、泰国有子公司（pdf 425–426、461）——香港公司属跨国企业集团成员（第 112 章 s15H）

roles.ULT.attrs.group_revenue_eur.formula: 2024 年集团收入 RMB909,750,000 ÷ 2024-12-31 欧元兑人民币中间价 7.5257（official/fx/cny_central_parity.csv）= EUR120,885,764.78；改期到 2026 年后沿用（门槛看此前四年，2025 年全年未披露）

holds.ULT>OP.cost.note: 对价 RMB3,484,473（2023-02-21，pdf 163）+ RMB140,000,000 + “RMB350,000,000 的等值美元”（2023-09-05，pdf 163、425）；美元部分的美元金额未披露，非居民的外币成本按扣缴义务发生日前一日的中间价折合人民币（公告2017年第37号）——计税成本由程序提问

flows.out.foreign_taxed.quote: distribution of profits earned by PRC companies since 1 January 2008 to foreign investors is subject to withholding tax of 5% or 10%, depending on if the foreign investor is considered as the beneficial owner of the dividend

flows.out.foreign_headline_rate.quote: The general corporate income tax rate in the PRC is 25%.

flows.out.deductible_at_payer.formula: 股息与减资返还都不是支付方的费用，不得扣除（企业所得税法第十条第一项、第八条）

flows.out.reduced_capital_ratio.quote: On February 12, 2025, the registered capital of Shanghai Jushuitan was decreased from RMB606,481,809 to RMB10,736,712.

present.repatriation.quote: On February 12, 2025, the registered capital of Shanghai Jushuitan was decreased from RMB606,481,809 to RMB10,736,712.
present.repatriation.basis: 注册资本已减少（pdf 539），是否向香港公司返还资金未披露；按减资返还处理，仅作测试

present.payment.basis: 支付是否跨年未披露，取当年支付

event.on.basis: 改期：真实减资日 2025-02-12，文库只存现行法（口径 D30），挪到 2026-02-12

event.dividend.quote: The consideration of RMB140,000,000 has been settled in 2023 and the remaining RMB350,000,000 as promissory notes receivable due from HK True Value were settled subsequently in March 2025 (Note 21).
event.dividend.basis: 减资是否返还、返还多少未披露；香港公司 2025 年 3 月清偿 RMB350,000,000 的本票，与 2 月减资的关系未披露——取 RMB350,000,000 作汇回额，仅作测试

notes: 来源：JST Group Corporation Limited（6687.HK，开曼注册）招股书 2025-10-13（cases/sources/K3-jst-2025/source.pdf）。K3 半合成：结构、比例、日期来自招股书，汇回额、方式与日期是合成值（见 provenance）。
只截取三地内的部分：ULT 为 Hong Kong True Value（香港中间控股，2021-10-04 注册），OP 为上海聚水潭（内地）；其上的 BVI 公司 True Value Limited 与开曼上市公司不在本例。集团另有香港聚水潭科技（持有人未披露），不在本例。

背景：红筹重组中 2023-02-21 境内股东以注册资本价（RMB1 / 每元注册资本）转让 91.35%，2023-09-05 新加坡 Broad Street 等四家以 RMB490,000,000 转让 8.65%（每家对价未披露）；卖方多为个人与合伙企业，不在 v1 范围内。2024-10-25 注册资本由 RMB3,814,351 增至 RMB606,481,809（来源未披露，可能是资本公积转增；若来自股本溢价，按国税函〔2010〕79号第四条不增加投资方计税基础），2025-02-12 减至 RMB10,736,712。
未披露：上海聚水潭的累计未分配利润与盈余公积（减资时按比例确认股息的部分）、香港公司的计税成本、经济实质、税务居民证明——留给程序发问。集团权益为负（pdf 428），各子公司的利润未分别披露。金额单位为人民币元。
